title: Code and data for trade-network GDP growth forecasting
description: Benchmark of 34 models for forecasting real GDP growth in 182 economies, testing whether trade networks help (spatio-temporal graph neural network, graph controls, IMF comparison), with conformal prediction intervals. The archive contains the code (training, graph controls, conformal prediction and report scripts), the processed panel and trade-graph data, the IMF World Economic Outlook historical forecasts, the World Bank extract, and the saved predictions, tables and figures. The raw BACI files (about 8 GB) are not included; download instructions are in data/README.md. Licences: code MIT; data keep the licences of their sources (CEPII BACI Etalab Open Licence 2.0, World Bank WDI CC BY 4.0, IMF WEO with credit to the IMF). Full instructions: https://github.com/MostafizurRahmanSani/trade-network-gdp-forecasting#readme
